english.note: Use this technical dental term for a prosthetic cap fitted over a tooth.

exampleSentences.english: The dentist said I need to have a crown replaced.
exampleSentences.traditional: 牙醫話要幫我換個牙冠。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngaa4 ji1 waa6 jiu3 bong1 ngo5 wun6 go3 ngaa4 gun1

english.note: Use this specifically for a dental crown covering a tooth.

exampleSentences.english: The dentist says this tooth needs a cap.
exampleSentences.traditional: 牙醫話呢隻牙要裝牙冠。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngaa4 ji1 waa6 ni1 zek3 ngaa4 jiu3 zong1 ngaa4 gun1
